[quote=greater_rostoria;59383023][b]June 15th, 1885.
Kingdom of Rostoria.[/b]

Alexei shoved spoonfuls of porridge into his mouth, making sure to scrape his wooden spoon to the bottom of the bowl to get everything into the utensil and finish his meal as quickly as possible. His mother was busy in the kitchen preparing lunch of her husband as she rapidly cut up carrots and slid them into a pot.

Alexei's father stood at a window overlooking the rest of the village as the townsfolk began to wake up in the early morning. His gaze was fixed on a group of Aarden that were walking outside of their wooden house to dry laundry and check on the chickens. His brows furrowed together and his mouth soured, clenching his teeth at the non-humans in his village. 

Once Alexei finished his meal he stood up from the table and walked up to his father, showing him the empty bowl as his father turned his gaze away and down at his son. "Good. Go put the bowl away and come with me to the market." Alexei quickly rushed into the kitchen and placed his bowl next to his mother, then running back to his father who still stood watching out of the window. His father angrily watched the Aarden go on with their day, watching them place the laundry on wires and making sure none of them were walking to his house.

Alexei looked up at his father and then outside, his eyes barely peeking over and seeing the Aarden across a dirt pathway. "What are you looking at, father?"

Alexei's father took a breath and walked outside his house, with Alexei following quickly behind. "Those Aarden...They came here a few days ago after kicking out Grisha. God be with Grisha, those Aarden must have forced him out with violence and now settle in his home, those violent creatures." Alexei's father walked up to the wooden fence of his house and closed the fence door behind him. "They are infesting our village. Just a few years ago we had no Aarden, now it seems half the houses have these pests in them." Alexei's father furiously exclaimed as Alexei barely followed behind his father.

"It's the communists and liberals, working together to end the white human race, Alexei. These Aarden are here to replace the human race." His father continued. Alexei looked confused and started side-eyeing the Aarden he passed by. "Why do they want to replace us?", Alexei pondered and tug on his father's hand.

"It's because we were made in God's image, we are his people. These Aarden however crawled out from the deepest pits of hell to replace God's chosen people. They are satanic worshippers, Alexei, you show them a crucifix and they recoil back." Alexei's father replied swiftly.

A passing Aarden would raise his hand to try and greet the father and son, but before the Aarden could speak a word, Alexei's father would spit at the feet of the non-human. He grabbed Alexei's hand and quickly walked away from the confused Aarden who stared at the ground in shock at what just happened.

"You know uncle Vera, right?" Alexei's father asked his son, with Alexei nodding. "Well these Aarden are responsible for his death. Took his home and forced him on the streets, he wandered the cities for weeks and yet still thought they would be kind enough to help him. Well, in the end he starved to death, his home is now occupied by a bunch of cat-folk." Alexei frowned thinking about Uncle Vera.

"Do not have pity for these things." Alexei's father said, "You give them food and water and they will repay you by stabbing you in the back. That is just their nature."[/quote]
Peak
Good morning
